redraw.definition:
v. t. To draw again; to make a second draft or copy of; to
   redraft.
v. i. To draw a new bill of exchange, as the holder of a
   protested bill, on the drawer or indorsers.
redraw.translation:
vt. 重画
vi. 刷新屏幕
[计] 刷新屏幕

redress.definition: n. act of correcting an error or a fault or an evil
redress.translation:
n. 赔偿, 补救, 矫正
vt. 纠正, 赔偿, 救济

redress of a grievance.translation: [法] 纠正冤情, 平反冤案

redress of wrongs.translation: [法] 损失赔偿, 补偿损失

redress the scales.translation:
作公平的调整, 主持公道
[法] 作公平的调整

redressed.definition: v make reparations or amends for
redressed.translation: v. 改正( redress的过去式和过去分词 ); 重加权衡; 恢复平衡

redresser.translation: 改正[修正, 调整, 补偿]者; 解调器

redresses.definition:

n act of correcting an error or a fault or an evil

redressible.definition: a. Such as may be redressed.

redroot.definition: n perennial woodland native of North America having a red root and red sap and bearing a solitary lobed leaf and white flower in early spring and having acrid emetic properties; rootstock used as a stimulant and expectorant
redroot.translation: n. [植] 美洲茶, 西风古, (=pigneed), (=blood root)

redrop.translation: v. 再掉下, 再投下
